content_sections.heading: About GEU Facilitator (iOS Development Centre)
content_sections.text: Graphic Era (Deemed to be) University, located in Clement Town, Dehradun, operates an iOS Development Centre. The university has announced recruitment for Facilitator positions to deliver hands-on training, build curriculum, mentor student developers, and support app development in Swift, SwiftUI, and Apple frameworks.

content_sections.text: Interested candidates should submit their CV to [email protected] with the subject line: Application for the post of (Position Applied for) – iOS Development Centre, GEU latest by 7th November 2026 up to 1700 Hrs. content_sections.heading: GEU Facilitator (iOS Development Centre) Job Description
content_sections.text: Deliver hands-on training in Swift, SwiftUI and Apple frameworks to student developers for building apps in iOS, MacOS, WatchOS. Develop curriculum and provide technical mentoring and support in development, deployment and troubleshooting. Collaborate with cross functional teams to facilitate students develop market ready apps. Conduct regular code reviews and improve and optimize the app with proper architecture as per industry standards. Help students prepare for Apple certification exams and for career in iOS development.
